# `/auth-org` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### GET /auth-org/v1/network-config

`getAuthOrgNetworkConfigV1` — Get security network configuration.

This API returns the details of an org's network auth configuration.

- Scopes: sp:auth-org:read
- Returns 200: networkconfiguration

### POST /auth-org/v1/network-config

`createAuthOrgNetworkConfigV1` — Create security network configuration.

This API returns the details of an org's network auth configuration. Requires security scope of: 'sp:auth-org:manage'

- Scopes: sp:auth-org:manage
- Body (application/json): networkconfiguration
- Returns 200: networkconfiguration

### PATCH /auth-org/v1/network-config

`patchAuthOrgNetworkConfigV1` — Update security network configuration.

This API updates an existing network configuration for an org using PATCH Requires security scope of: 'sp:auth-org:manage'

- Scopes: sp:auth-org:manage
- Body (application/json-patch+json): array of jsonpatchoperation
- Returns 200: networkconfiguration

### GET /auth-org/v1/lockout-config

`getAuthOrgLockoutConfigV1` — Get auth org lockout configuration.

This API returns the details of an org's lockout auth configuration.

- Scopes: sp:auth-org:read
- Returns 200: lockoutconfiguration

### PATCH /auth-org/v1/lockout-config

`patchAuthOrgLockoutConfigV1` — Update auth org lockout configuration

This API updates an existing lockout configuration for an org using PATCH

- Scopes: sp:auth-org:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, HELPDESK
- Body (application/json-patch+json): array of jsonpatchoperation
- Returns 200: lockoutconfiguration

### GET /auth-org/v1/service-provider-config

`getAuthOrgServiceProviderConfigV1` — Get service provider configuration.

This API returns the details of an org's service provider auth configuration.

- Scopes: sp:auth-org:read 
- Returns 200: serviceproviderconfiguration

### PATCH /auth-org/v1/service-provider-config

`patchAuthOrgServiceProviderConfigV1` — Update service provider configuration

This API updates an existing service provider configuration for an org using PATCH.

- Scopes: sp:auth-org:manage
- Body (application/json-patch+json): array of jsonpatchoperation
- Returns 200: serviceproviderconfiguration

### GET /auth-org/v1/session-config

`getAuthOrgSessionConfigV1` — Get auth org session configuration.

This API returns the details of an org's session auth configuration.

- Scopes: sp:auth-org:read
- Returns 200: sessionconfiguration

### PATCH /auth-org/v1/session-config

`patchAuthOrgSessionConfigV1` — Update auth org session configuration

This API updates an existing session configuration for an org using PATCH.

- Scopes: sp:auth-org:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, HELPDESK
- Body (application/json-patch+json): array of jsonpatchoperation
- Returns 200: sessionconfiguration
